name: movie_betcep_lpqi_pulsation
label: Movie: beta Cep on the LPQI-Pathfinder, the pulsating diameter (one night, then a season folded on the 4.57 h period; 550 nm, MPD)
notes: 550 nm filter: its first null (1.22 lambda/theta = 430 m) lies inside the night's 330-530 m sweep; in H-alpha the null sits at the far end of the track.

Act one: the night track as for delta Ori, with theta(t) breathing by 1 % on the 0.19048 d radial pulsation. Act two: 60 nights folded on pulsation phase, the phase-binned diameter converging on the model curve.
Radius amplitude 1 % ASSUMED from the ~20 km/s radial-velocity amplitude over P = 4.57 h on R = 7.2 Rsun; to be replaced by the published value.
